title: Special Executive Masters Programme in International Marketing Strategy
description: The encapsulated Senior Executive Programme in International Marketing Strategy is for high-performance managers and directors who work in critical roles using available resources to effectively produce products and services that satisfy the customers.
longDescription: Course Overview The GSS Special Executive Masters Programme (SEMP) in International Marketing Strategy allows you to update your skills, develop new skills, and explore and develop interests in a wide range of topics. These courses can be taken as personal or professional development and may enhance your employability. The encapsulated Special Executive Masters Programme in International Marketing Strategy is for high-performance managers and directors who work in critical roles using available resources to produce products and services that satisfy the customers effectively. The Programme is also useful for managers and directors who need an intensive course to cover the key areas that drive success and profit in everyday business marketing. This Programme is designed to give you a comprehensive understanding of the key skills and practices used by marketing executives and their organizations to make informed marketing decisions vital to any business's success. Participants will learn how to critically evaluate key marketing models and apply them to a real-life business problem at a strategic level.
courseDetails: Mode of Study Using Web-based technology, this program provides self-paced, individualized instruction that can be taken anywhere and anytime an individual has access to a computer and the Internet. This programme is suitable for successful professionals or specialists in the private, public, or voluntary sectors who have new management responsibilities and need to expand their management knowledge quickly. This Programme serves as a refresher course for those who had their Master's a long time ago and need quick reminders and professional/ academic updates, while it serves as a primer for those very experienced Professionals who never made time out for their master's yet require the academic and practical relevance of this master’s experience. It is a short executive training that runs online for 6 months. Upon successful completion of the Programme, candidates will be awarded a Continuing Professional Development (CPD) certificate in the specific Programme they have completed. What is a CPD Course? Continuing Professional Development (CPD) is how professionals maintain and enhance their knowledge and skills. The world is constantly moving at a very fast pace. Hence, undertaking CPD is essential to support a professional in his/her current role as well as helping them with career progression. CPD is all about upgrading knowledge, skills, and capabilities to remain effective and compliant. A CPD course is an investment that you make in yourself. It’s a way of planning your development that links learning directly to practice. CPD can help you keep your skills and knowledge up to date and prepare you for greater responsibilities. It can boost your confidence, strengthen your professional credibility, and help you become more creative in tackling new challenges. Is SEMP International Marketing the right Programme for me? If you want to understand how to align marketing strategies with business strategy and how high-performing business leaders make better decisions about their products, services, customers, brand, and competition, then this is just the right Programme for you. Why SEMP International Marketing? This Programme is designed to give you a comprehensive understanding of the key skills and practices used by marketing executives and their organizations to make informed marketing decisions vital to any business's success. Participants will learn how to critically evaluate key marketing models and apply them to a real-life business problem at a strategic level. This 100% online certificate enhances your understanding of the role of marketing in organizational strategy and highlights the advantages of using a cross-functional perspective to lead successful companies or units. By the end of six months, you will have worked through several case studies, have access to numerous online academic materials, interacted with peers from different countries and backgrounds, and also have received directions from the best business trainers in the business world today. Who Should Enrol in This Online Certificate Program? The SEMP International Marketing Strategy Programme is designed for entry-level managers, up to mid-level managers, senior managers, or directors who are in a general marketing role or fast approaching such positions and are seeking an opportunity to obtain a richer, deeper understanding of marketing skills. modules.title: MARKETING COMMUNICATION
modules.summary: In this course of Marketing communication we will explores the various methods and strategies used to effectively promote and sell products or services to a target audience. Through this course, students will gain an understanding of the key principles and techniques involved in developing successful marketing campaigns, including advertising, public relations, social media, and branding. Students will also learn how to analyze consumer behavior, develop messaging and creative content, and measure the effectiveness of marketing efforts.

lessons.title: Strategic Role of Branding in Marketing Communication

modules.title: INTERNATIONAL MARKETING
modules.summary: The Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Marketing is designed to fit around work and personal commitments. World-class teaching is delivered via pre-recorded online lectures to enrich the learning experience. GSS has perfected the art of delivering practical marketing management education. Our practice-based approach focuses on addressing real-world marketing and communication problems. We don’t just give you the theory; we ensure you learn how to apply it in your working life immediately, with case studies, webinars, business simulations, and 100% project-based. The Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Marketing allows you to achieve the qualification between 8 to 10 months, so it is a fast track to new opportunities and enhanced career prospects. The purpose of this programme is to deliver an enhanced view of the marketing concepts and practices aimed at steering your business to new heights of reach and customization, which in turn is supported by appropriate reference to theoretical and conceptual analysis.

lessons.title: Nature and Scope of International Marketing
Trade Distortion and the Marketing Barriers

modules.title: MARKETING MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: In this course, students will learn how to identify market opportunities, analyze consumer behavior, and develop effective marketing strategies to meet customer needs and achieve business goals. Topics covered in the course may include market research, product development, pricing strategies, distribution channels, and promotion tactics. Students will also gain an understanding of how to measure the effectiveness of marketing efforts and adjust strategies accordingly.

lessons.title: Understanding External and Internal Environment for designing a market plan
CASE STUDY - How Starbucks is using pricing strategy for profit maximization
Marketing Function Interrelationships and Entrepreneurial Marketing
CASE STUDY - MasterCard Global Targeted Content Marketing
Strategic Positioning In the Business Environment
CASE STUDY - Starbucks's Misunderstandings In Australia
RESEARCH - Market entry strategies of passenger carmakers
Understanding Brand Identity Personality And Positioning

modules.title: STRATEGIC LEADERSHIP
modules.summary: Through this course, students will gain an understanding of how to formulate and implement effective business strategies, develop organizational structures, and create a culture of innovation and excellence. The course will also cover topics such as decision-making, risk management, and ethical leadership. Students will learn how to analyze the competitive landscape, identify opportunities for growth, and develop strategies that leverage their organization's strengths to achieve success.

lessons.title: Understanding the Principles, Concepts, and Approaches to Leadership
CASE STUDY - King of the Hill
Understanding Leadership Influences: Individual, Team and The Organisation
CASE STUDY - How Google builds the perfect team
Ethical Decision Making And Organisational Value
CASE STUDY - Collaboration Shifts a Dysfunctional Culture

modules.title: INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: Through this course, students will gain an understanding of the key principles and strategies involved in managing international business operations, including market entry strategies, global supply chain management, cross-cultural communication, and international trade regulations. Students will also learn how to analyze global market trends, assess risk factors, and develop effective strategies for competing in a global marketplace.

modules.title: ADVANCED BUSINESS RESEARCH METHODS
modules.summary: The aim of this course is to develop learners’ ability to prepare for various types of academically based management research through the development and design of a research proposal. Learners will develop a critical understanding of the philosophical, practical and ethical concepts of research within the context of the business environment.
